content_blocks.text: Choosing a Dart SDK Installation Method matters because Dart programs need predictable behavior, explicit contracts, and examples that can be verified. This topic focuses on standalone Dart SDK versus the Dart SDK included with Flutter. Keep the lesson’s core distinction separate from runtime, SDK, package, or platform details that may vary. When you build on this idea, state your assumptions, try the smallest useful example, and check edge cases before integrating it into a larger project.
